name: Abertoir
blurb: The International Horror Festival of Wales: horror film screenings, special guests and events at Aberystwyth Arts Centre.
notes: Abertoir skipped its usual 5-day November festival in 2026: a 19 Aug 2026 site post ('Abertoir's not-so-fallow year revealed!') says there 'won't be a big, 5-day festival this year', running one-off standalone screenings through autumn 2026 instead and promising 'a full event in 2027' with no dates yet announced. The last full edition was the 20th-anniversary festival, 12-16 Nov 2025 in Aberystwyth (confirmed via web search).
